limitations: This review covers only the three listed cases and six original PNGs in reference-11; it does not establish that the full round is clean.
Each PNG was actually viewed with tools.view_image. No PNG was resampled, modified, or regenerated for review.

Only existing JSON and PNG evidence was read, PNG bytes were hashed, and this review document was written. No application, build, test suite, smoke test, runtime probe, Git operation, or product modification was performed.

Static screenshots establish visible layout and control presence, but do not prove click behavior, successful retry execution, source selection, keyboard transitions, active Pinyin composition, candidate selection, or candidate paging.

Both candidate editing captures have empty composition and candidate arrays. The reference active qi composition cannot be directly compared with an equivalent candidate composition state in this batch.
The images establish software-rendered grayscale appearance only; physical e-ink rendering and hardware input behavior are outside this evidence.
